name: Persona 2: Innocent Sin
aliases: Shin Megami Tensei: Persona 2 – Innocent Sin

locations.note: In Sumaru City, a seaside city whose districts the developers based on Shibuya, Yamate and Odaiba, rumours start coming true; Tatsuya Suou and his Seven Sisters friends hunt the Joker until the city is lifted into the sky as the spaceship Xibalba.
